description: Angular component class for configuring alarms table widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form initialization, default settings, and validation logic.

classes.name: AlarmsTableWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing alarms table widget settings, extending WidgetSettingsComponent, with form controls and validation.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the alarms table widget.

methods.name: prepareInputSettings
methods.description: Prepares and adjusts input settings, especially page step size values.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.
